hits.name: Trail Runner Canvas Sneaker
hits.description: Bone canvas construction defines this lightweight Waybound Trail Runner, engineered for breathable comfort on both rugged trails and casual road-trip adventures. The low-profile design delivers responsive support for hikers seeking versatile everyday wear.
hits.imagePrompt: Low-profile canvas sneaker in bone, breathable trail design with hiking-ready traction and minimalist road-trip aesthetic.

hits.name: Camp Slip-On Shoe
hits.description: The moss Camp Slip-On Shoe features a durable, comfortable design perfect for road trips and everyday wear. Easy slip-on style keeps you moving without the hassle of laces.
hits.imagePrompt: Moss green canvas slip-on camp shoe with cushioned footbed, relaxed silhouette, reinforced sole, displayed from side angle on neutral background.

hits.name: Low-Profile Canvas Trail Sneaker
hits.description: The walnut Low-Profile Canvas Trail Sneaker from Waybound offers rugged durability and everyday comfort in a sleek, compact design. Built with sturdy canvas and trail-ready construction, it's your go-to shoe for adventures both on and off the path.
hits.imagePrompt: Low-profile women's trail sneaker in walnut canvas, durable everyday design, side view on white background, clean minimalist styling

hits.name: Slip-On Camp Shoe
hits.description: The Waybound Slip-On Camp Shoe in saddle-tan is the perfect easy-to-wear option for casual days and weekend adventures. Designed with a relaxed fit, this slip-on style keeps you comfortable whether you're lounging at camp or running errands around town.
hits.imagePrompt: Relaxed women's slip-on camp shoe in saddle-tan suede, featuring comfortable elastic goring and a casual, easy-to-wear aesthetic.
